critical_code_review_comments: InboxPage.openProProfile at line 190-194 reads otherUser.id but the backend response uses 'id' (good), however the button render at line 299 only checks otherUser?.role — if the thread is opened but the GET /api/messages/thread response hasn't completed, otherUser is null and the button shouldn't render — yet test showed it WAS rendered & clicked but did not navigate. Strongly suggests a React state ordering bug or that the 'other_user' field on /api/messages/threads list (the inbox sidebar) lacks an id and the otherUser snapshot used by handler is the sidebar's, not the resolved thread one.
InboxPage line 192 `otherUser.id` — defensive code: use otherUser?.id || activeThread?.other_user_id as fallback before bailing out.

rca_of_the_issue: InboxPage header-view-profile navigation failure: Button renders only when `otherUser?.role === 'tradesperson'`, and handler navigates to `/pros/${otherUser.id}` only if `otherUser?.role === 'tradesperson'`. Backend GET /api/messages/thread returns {other_user: {id, name, role}} so the value should exist. Two probable causes: (1) The button click fires while otherUser is still the previous thread's user — React state batching delay; openThread() (line 67) calls api.get then setOtherUser, which is async; if the user clicks before the GET resolves, otherUser may be stale OR null but the COMPONENT KEY is unchanged so button keeps stale role. (2) navigate() from react-router-dom may be silently no-op if the pathname includes special chars (unlikely since IDs are hex). Repro: Login as homeowner@test.com, open /messages, click any thread → click the small 'View Profile' chip in the inbox header. Expected: navigate to /pros/<pro_user_id>. Actual: URL stays at /messages. Mitigation: change `onClick={openProProfile}` to `onClick={() => { const id = otherUser?.id || other_pro_id; if (id) navigate('/pros/' + id); }}` AND/OR disable the button when !otherUser?.id.
